content_of_post_to_comment: I don’t like telling white lies either, but it’s not a modern culture thing. I was reading Three Kingdoms, written 500 years ago, and half those old Chinese warlords were pulling a sickie to get out of awkward meetings with the boss.
comment: Maybe the real historical constant isn’t lying, but the need to make avoidance sound respectable. “I’m sick” and “I’m busy” are just socially acceptable ways of saying “I don’t want to deal with this.”
